services.title: Roof Repair
services.short: Leaks, missing shingles and storm damage, put right.
services.text: From minor leaks to major storm damage, our roof repair services restore your roof's integrity without unnecessary upselling.
body: From minor shingle damage to major leak restoration, our roof repair services in Pasadena help you extend the life of your roof and protect your home. We perform comprehensive assessments and address issues such as missing shingles, storm damage, flashing problems, and more.
We diagnose issues thoroughly and perform repairs using materials that match your existing system for a seamless finish.
points: Materials matched to your existing system

services.title: Roof Replacement
services.short: Full tear-off and a new roof, usually in one to two days.
services.text: Is your roof over 20 years old or showing signs of failure like curling shingles or sagging? We remove and replace aging or failing roofs with precision and care.
body: When repairs aren't enough, our roof replacement service ensures a complete upgrade using top-rated materials like Owens Corning, TAMKO and CertainTeed. We offer architectural shingles, energy-efficient options, and full tear-offs.

Whether the cause is storm damage or age, we guide you through every step, from choosing materials to coordinating insurance claims, improving your property's value, energy efficiency, and protection.
points: Owens Corning, TAMKO and CertainTeed materials

faqs.q: How long does it take to complete a roof replacement?
faqs.a: Most residential roof replacements are completed within 1 to 2 days, depending on weather, roof size, and material. For larger or multi-family projects, timelines are customized based on scope.

faqs.q: How much does a new roof cost in Pasadena, TX?
faqs.a: Roof pricing depends on the material, square footage, slope, and labor requirements. On average, an asphalt shingle roof replacement can cost between $7,000 and $12,000. We offer roof financing options to help make your project more affordable.

faqs.q: How do I know if my roof needs to be replaced?
faqs.a: If your roof is more than 20 years old, showing signs of curling shingles, persistent leaks, or sagging areas, it may be time for a roof replacement. Our team can perform a detailed roof inspection and provide honest recommendations based on your home's condition.

services.title: Roof Installation
services.short: New construction and remodels, built to code and to spec.
services.text: Our expert roof installation services cater to new construction and remodels alike, with multiple slope and material options tailored to your vision and budget.
body: Building a new home or addition? We customize solutions based on roof pitch, material preferences, and design goals, and we assist with ventilation, decking, underlayment, and shingle selection.
Our roof installation process follows strict manufacturer guidelines and local building codes to ensure long-term performance and warranty protection.
points: Manufacturer guidelines and local building codes
Warranty protection on the finished system

services.title: Roof Inspection
services.short: A free, detailed look at your roof with photos and a report.
services.text: Don't wait until you see water stains. Schedule a roof inspection to assess damage, age, and insurance eligibility.
body: We provide detailed reports, photos, and recommendations tailored to your roof's condition. Our Pasadena roofing specialists check structural integrity, ventilation, water damage, flashing, and more.

Whether it's routine maintenance or a storm-related review, we provide honest, thorough insights. Inspections are free for homeowners and commercial clients, and they are the first step in identifying leaks, wind damage, hail impact, or age-related wear.
points: Free for homeowners and commercial clients

faqs.q: Do you offer free roof inspections?
faqs.a: Yes, we provide free roof inspections to homeowners and commercial clients. It's the first step in identifying leaks, wind damage, hail impact, or age-related wear.

services.title: Residential Roofing
services.short: Tailored roofing for homes across Pasadena and Houston.
services.text: Our residential roofing services protect and enhance homes in Pasadena using top-tier materials and techniques.
body: Your home deserves protection and curb appeal. Our residential roofing services offer tailored solutions, including asphalt shingles, metal panels, tile roofing, and more.
We treat every project like it's our own, with clear timelines and guaranteed quality.
points: Tile roofing in clay and concrete

services.title: Asphalt Shingle Roofing
services.short: The most popular roofing material in Texas, installed and repaired.
services.text: Affordable, durable, and versatile, asphalt shingles are the most popular roofing material in Texas. We install and repair all types, including architectural and impact-resistant options.
body: Asphalt shingle roofing provides affordable and durable solutions for residential properties, and architectural shingles are the right fit for most homes in Pasadena.
We install GAF, CertainTeed, Owens Corning, TAMKO and Atlas lines, and we help you weigh roof pitch, local building codes, budget and weather exposure before you choose.
points: Manufacturer warranties up to lifetime limited
Repairs as well as full installs

services.title: Metal Roofing
services.short: Standing seam and corrugated systems that resist wind and fire.
services.text: Ideal for energy efficiency and longevity, metal roofing resists wind, fire, and rot. Our standing seam and corrugated systems bring performance and style.
body: Metal roofing boosts energy efficiency and resists harsh elements, which matters in a climate with heavy rainfall, high UV exposure and high winds.
Metal systems often carry 30 to 50 year material warranties covering corrosion and finish degradation.

services.title: Tile Roofing
services.short: Clay and concrete tile, installed and repaired for Gulf Coast weather.
services.text: Clay and concrete tiles offer unmatched elegance and durability. We specialize in tile roof installations and repairs tailored for Gulf Coast weather.
body: Tile roofing in clay or concrete adds elegance and longevity, and it holds up well against coastal storms.
With professional installation and regular maintenance, tile warranties can run as long as 75 years.

services.title: Slate Roofing
services.short: True and synthetic slate, with a lifespan over 100 years.
services.text: A premium choice, slate offers natural beauty and 100+ years of longevity. We install and maintain true and synthetic slate systems with precision.
body: Slate roofing offers premium beauty with a lifespan of over 100 years, and it is one of the longest-lasting systems available on a Texas home.
We install and maintain both true and synthetic slate, and warranties on slate and tile can cover 75 years or more with professional installation and regular maintenance.

services.title: Water Damage Repair
services.short: Stop the intrusion, then repair what the water reached.
services.text: Leaks and moisture can ruin insulation and drywall. We address the source of water intrusion and repair interior and exterior damage.
body: Water damage repair addresses moisture intrusion to prevent interior and exterior issues, and it starts with finding where the water is actually getting in.
We handle every step in-house, from initial cleanup to final restoration, and we help document the damage if your insurer is involved.
points: Source of intrusion found and sealed

services.title: Emergency Roofing
services.short: On call 24/7 to tarp, stabilize and protect after a storm.
services.text: Texas storms don't wait, and neither do we. Our emergency roofing team is on call 24/7 to tarp, stabilize, and protect your home after wind or hail damage.
body: When severe storms strike, our emergency roofing team is on call 24/7. From emergency tarping to structural stabilization, we act quickly to protect your home or business from water intrusion and safety hazards.
In most cases we can be onsite the same day to mitigate damage from hail, high winds, or fallen trees. Count on us for fast action and compassionate service during stressful situations.

faqs.q: How fast can you respond to a roofing emergency in Pasadena?
faqs.a: We provide 24/7 emergency roofing and roof tarping services. In most cases, we can be onsite the same day to mitigate damage from hail, high winds, or fallen trees.

faqs.q: What should I do after a storm damages my roof?
faqs.a: Start by calling our emergency roofing team. We'll provide fast roof tarping to prevent further damage and guide you through the insurance claims process.

services.title: Roof Tarping
services.short: A temporary shield until the permanent repair is scheduled.
services.text: When damage hits unexpectedly, roof tarping acts as a temporary shield, preventing further water penetration until permanent repairs are made.
body: Temporary but critical, our roof tarping services prevent further damage after a storm or major leak. We install durable tarps to cover damaged areas until a full repair or replacement can be scheduled.
This service is often used as part of our emergency response and insurance support process.
points: Bridges the gap to a permanent repair

services.title: Roofing Insurance Claims
services.short: Documentation, adjuster meetings and restoration after a storm.
services.text: We document the damage, help you file, meet your adjuster on site, and handle the restoration once the claim is approved.
body: Roof damage isn't always obvious. Hail often results in bruised or cracked shingles, granule loss, and damage to vents or flashing; wind can tear off shingles or lift roofing materials; falling trees and wind-driven rain do the rest. Texas sees over 500 severe hail events each year, which is why Pasadena-area properties should be inspected after storm seasons.

A contractor present during the adjuster visit means no damage is overlooked, and proper documentation, photos and reports significantly lower the chance of denial. We're proud to serve as a local resource for Pasadena residents dealing with roof damage, and we believe you shouldn't face the claims process alone.
points: Hail damage, including bruising and granule loss
Wind damage and lifted or torn shingles
On-site adjuster support and full documentation

faqs.q: What roof damage is typically covered by insurance in Texas?
faqs.a: Most homeowners' insurance policies in Texas cover sudden and accidental damage, such as hail, high winds, and falling tree limbs.

faqs.q: How long do I have to file a roof insurance claim in Texas?
faqs.a: Most Texas insurance companies require claims to be filed within 1 year of the damaging event, though some policies may allow only 6 months. It's best to act quickly and contact us after any major storm.

faqs.q: What happens if my roof claim is denied?
faqs.a: Denials can often be appealed. We'll review the denial, look for documentation gaps, and help you through the process to improve your chances of approval on appeal.

faqs.q: Will filing a roof insurance claim increase my premiums?
faqs.a: Not always. In Texas, damage from natural events like hail or hurricanes is considered an act of God and usually won't cause premium hikes. However, frequent claims or damage due to neglect might impact rates.

services.title: Commercial Roofing
services.short: Watertight systems for warehouses, offices, churches and retail.
services.text: Our commercial roofing solutions support warehouses, offices, churches, and retail properties. We provide watertight systems that meet energy codes and building specs.
body: Our commercial roofing solutions are engineered for performance, durability, and energy efficiency in demanding business environments.
Commercial roofing involves flat or low-slope systems like TPO or modified bitumen, and our crews are trained to handle both commercial and residential work with precision.
points: Systems that meet energy codes and building specs

faqs.q: Are your roofing services available for commercial buildings?
faqs.a: Yes. We offer a full suite of commercial roofing services, including TPO, modified bitumen, and EPDM roofing. Our team handles everything from initial consultation to installation and maintenance.

services.title: TPO Roofing
services.short: Energy-efficient, UV-resistant membrane for low-slope roofs.
services.text: Thermoplastic polyolefin (TPO) membranes are energy-efficient and UV-resistant, ideal for flat or low-slope commercial roofs.
body: TPO is a single-ply membrane that reflects heat rather than absorbing it, which keeps a building cooler through a Texas summer and takes load off the cooling system.
Flat roofing systems in TPO carry system warranties of up to 20 to 30 years with proper maintenance.
points: System warranties up to 20 to 30 years

services.title: Modified Bitumen Roofing
services.short: Multiple layers of waterproofing, built for Texas heat.
services.text: Built to withstand Texas heat, modified bitumen offers multiple layers of protection and excellent waterproofing for flat and low-slope roofs.
body: Modified bitumen roofing offers multilayer protection for heat-resistant roofing, which suits buildings that take full sun all day.
Like our other flat roofing systems, it carries system warranties of up to 20 to 30 years with proper maintenance.
points: System warranties up to 20 to 30 years

services.title: EPDM Roofing
services.short: Synthetic rubber membrane with high flexibility.
services.text: EPDM roofing uses synthetic rubber for flexibility and weather resistance.
body: Ethylene propylene diene monomer (EPDM) is a synthetic rubber roofing membrane with high flexibility and weather resistance, which lets it move with a building instead of cracking.
It is one of the three flat roof systems we install, alongside TPO and modified bitumen, and it is eligible for our roof financing.
points: System warranties up to 20 to 30 years

services.title: Flat Roofing
services.short: Membranes that resist ponding and UV degradation.
services.text: Our flat roofing systems are designed for commercial buildings, garages, and modern-style homes. We provide high-performance membranes that resist ponding and UV degradation.
body: From homes to commercial buildings, flat roofs require expert drainage, materials, and installation techniques. Our flat roofing systems are built to perform and resist ponding.
We specify TPO, EPDM or modified bitumen depending on the building, the exposure and how the roof is used.
points: Commercial buildings, garages and modern homes
TPO, EPDM and modified bitumen options
System warranties up to 20 to 30 years

services.title: Multi-Family Roofing
services.short: Apartments, condos and duplexes, with minimal disruption to tenants.
services.text: From duplexes to apartment complexes, our multi-family roofing services are built to protect large residential structures with minimal disruption to tenants.
body: We provide large-scale roofing for apartments, condos, and duplexes. With project management expertise, we deliver quality on budget and on schedule.
Timelines on multi-family work are customized based on scope rather than quoted off a standard, and we schedule around the people living in the building.

services.title: Construction Services
services.short: General contracting, remodeling and exterior work beyond the roof.
services.text: We are a general contractor as well as a roofer, handling interior remodeling, exterior improvements, commercial build-outs and storm damage restoration for homeowners, business owners, property managers and real estate investors.
body: As your general contractor we oversee every stage of construction, communicate progress clearly, coordinate schedules and make sure each phase is completed according to plan. We manage projects of all sizes while keeping workmanship consistent from beginning to end.

Inside, we handle kitchen and bathroom remodeling, drywall, interior painting, flooring, ceiling repairs, framing modifications, trim and finish carpentry, window and door installation and water damage restoration. Outside, we handle siding, exterior painting, gutters, soffit and fascia, decks, patios, fences, concrete repairs and exterior remodeling.

On the commercial side we complete office renovations, retail build-outs, warehouse improvements, tenant finish-outs and restaurant renovations with organized project management and dependable scheduling, so a business can keep operating while the work goes on. We also carry out routine property repairs and preventative building maintenance that address wear before it becomes a larger construction issue.
points: General contracting across every stage of a project
Siding, gutters, soffit and fascia, decks, patios and fences
Office, retail, warehouse and tenant finish-out construction
Storm damage restoration and preventative maintenance

about.title: Built on faith and strength
text: The name 12 Stones is more than symbolic; it's a calling. Inspired by Joshua 4 in the Bible, our identity is rooted in the story of the Israelites crossing the Jordan River, where God instructed them to gather 12 stones as a memorial to His faithfulness. Like those stones, 12 Stones Roofing & Construction stands as a symbol of strength, reliability and enduring faith.

Our mission is to serve the community, both commercially and residentially, with the most qualified, uncompromising workmanship and service. We don't just want to be the best; we want to be the most trusted, the most dependable, and the most faithful roofing company in Texas. That means showing up on time, doing the job right, and honoring our word.

Our vision is that God, through 12 men whose hearts are set on Him, will revolutionize the roofing industry. From humble beginnings we have grown into one of the top 1% of licensed construction service providers in Texas, and as a Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business we bring discipline, accountability and a strong sense of duty to every job.

With a local office right on Olson Lane, we're deeply connected to the Pasadena community. When extreme Texas weather hits, your roof is the first line of defense, and we make sure it holds strong. Our roofing professionals are manufacturer-certified, background-checked, and trained in the latest safety and installation methods, with annual training in OSHA safety and product innovation.

facts.heading: Warranties
facts.text: We provide multiple layers of warranty protection: manufacturer warranties covering defects in materials such as shingles, metal or underlayment; a workmanship warranty covering installation errors and labor for a set number of years; a system warranty covering the full roof including flashing, vents, accessories and underlayment; and extended warranties on select projects, including the Diamond Warranty option. Coverage runs roughly 20 years to lifetime on asphalt shingles, 30 to 50 years on metal, 20 to 30 years on flat systems and 75 years or more on slate and tile. Many of our warranties are transferable to a new homeowner, and we register manufacturer warranties for you. Storm damage is not a warranty matter but an insurance one, and coverage can be voided by poor ventilation or by alterations made without approval.

facts.heading: Financing
facts.text: We've partnered with financing providers to spread the cost of roofing work. Many plans offer $0 down and deferred payments for qualified applicants, with low or no-interest options and flexible terms across a range of credit profiles. Financing covers repairs, replacements, new installations, emergency work, flat and commercial systems, residential and multi-family roofing, and gutter and storm damage services. The process runs free estimate, application, review and approval, then scheduling, and once financing is approved we can typically begin within a few days.

facts.heading: Safety and compliance
facts.text: We follow OSHA standards, use fall-protection gear, and work to the building standards and safety protocols issued by the City of Pasadena Planning Department and the residential codes enforced under the Texas Department of Licensing & Regulation. Our crews are vetted and insured, all debris is removed from your site, and we protect landscaping and driveways during every job. We aim to leave every job site looking better than it did when we arrived.
